The country's exports recorded a 16.6% increase in April-September this fiscal and India is on track to hit the $1 trillion exports target in 2026-27, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).
Talking in a session organised by the industry chamber FICCI, the Secretary said despite global uncertainties on the trade front, India is doing well.
"We are on track to hit $1 trillion exports [of goods and services] this year," Mr. Agrawal said.
Last fiscal, India had touched an all-time high of $863 billion.
He said that in uncertain times, India has an advantage as a "trusted" trading partner.
